# ZipStreamHub
> High-performance zero-download streaming server & virtual archive extractor for remote ZIP / ZIP64 archives.

ZipStreamHub converts remote ZIP/ZIP64 files into instantly playable, random-seekable HTTP 1.1 streams for media players (PotPlayer, MPV, VLC, IINA) and web browsers without downloading or storing any files on local disk.

## Quick Reference
- Main Repository & Docs: https://github.com/mermis/zipstreamhub
- Full Documentation for LLMs: /llms-full.txt
- Architecture Deep Dive: /docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
- REST API Reference: /docs/API.md
- Troubleshooting Guide: /docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md
- Non-Coder Visual Guide: /docs/QUICKSTART_NON_CODERS.md

## Core Capabilities
- **Zero-Download HTTP 206 Streaming**: Translates client player byte-range requests directly to remote ZIP file byte offsets with STORE compression.
- **Sub-Second Tail Parsing**: Reads End of Central Directory (EOCD `0x06054b50`) and ZIP64 Locator (`0x07064b50`) in ~0.6s without fetching the entire archive.
- **Sliding-Window Buffer**: Multi-threaded `StreamPrefetcher` with 32MB configurable read-ahead and 128KB socket slices.
- **Native Player Integration**: Auto-detects and triggers MPV, PotPlayer, VLC, and IINA via CLI and Web UI.
- **Cross-Platform**: Windows, macOS, Linux, and Docker support.

## Endpoints Summary
- `POST /api/inspect`: Accepts `{"url": "<zip_url>"}`. Parses Central Directory and returns archive structure with file list and byte offsets.
- `POST /api/play`: Accepts `{"url": "<stream_url>"}`. Auto-detects and launches local media player.
- `GET /stream/<id>/<filename>`: Exposes an HTTP 206 Partial Content byte-range stream for the selected file inside the remote archive.
- `GET /`: Serves the glassmorphism web control panel.

## CLI Usage
```bash
# Start server
python server.py

# Interactive CLI player
python cli.py "<zip_url>"

# Direct player launch
python cli.py "<zip_url>" --player potplayer --ep 1
```

## Architecture Summary
1. Client requests remote ZIP URL.
2. `RemoteZipReader` fetches last 1MB via HTTP Range to parse EOCD (`0x06054b50`), ZIP64 EOCD Locator (`0x07064b50`), and Central Directory (`0x02014b50`).
3. Local file headers (`0x04034b50`) are parsed on demand to resolve exact `data_offset`.
4. `StreamPrefetcher` uses `urllib3.PoolManager` with persistent HTTP keep-alive connections to prefetch 32MB upstream blocks and slice them into 128KB packets for the client.
